digest: Investigation confirms that the critical malware and ransomware alerts are false positives, triggered by a scheduled and approved detection-validation exercise (CHG-4821) conducted in an isolated BUILD-LAB environment. No actual compromise, data encryption, credential theft, or external command-and-control occurred. All observed activities were part of a controlled simulation.

evidence_findings.title: Scheduled Detection Validation Exercise
evidence_findings.subject: Case Context
evidence_findings.evidence: Case comments and artifact notes explicitly state this is 'the scheduled quarterly detection-validation exercise CHG-4821 in the isolated BUILD-LAB network' and 'Execution was initiated by service account svc_detection_test under approved change CHG-4821.'
evidence_findings.conclusion: The observed activities are part of an authorized and planned simulation.

evidence_findings.title: Isolated Environment and Network Containment
evidence_findings.subject: Network Isolation
evidence_findings.evidence: CMDB identifies involved hosts as 'isolated cyber-range assets with no route to production.' Firewall logs confirm 'the isolated range blocked all external egress during the exercise.'
evidence_findings.conclusion: The simulated activities were contained within a non-production environment, preventing any real-world impact.

evidence_findings.title: Non-Destructive Simulation Outcome
evidence_findings.subject: Simulated Attack Behavior
evidence_findings.evidence: The process 'attack-simulator.exe' ran with '--scenario ransomware-safe --no-encryption'. EDR recorded 'simulation markers only: no file encryption, credential access, persistence, or payload download occurred.'
evidence_findings.conclusion: The simulated attack was non-destructive and did not achieve actual malicious objectives or cause harm.

attack_chain.description: An approved service account, svc_detection_test, initiated the attack-simulator.exe on BUILD-LAB-03.
The attack-simulator.exe process ran with parameters indicating a ransomware-safe scenario, without actual encryption.
Internal network traffic from 10.250.0.23 (BUILD-LAB-03) to SIM-CONTROLLER-01 (10.250.0.10) on port 8443 was observed, simulating C2 beaconing within the isolated lab.

attack_timeline.attack_behavior: Initial detection of simulated activity, leading to case creation.
Analyst comment confirming the activity as a scheduled detection-validation exercise.

ioc_indicators.context: Executed on BUILD-LAB-03 as part of a simulation.
Internal exercise controller (SIM-CONTROLLER-01) for simulated C2.
Source of simulated C2 traffic from BUILD-LAB-03.
Destination port for simulated C2 traffic to the exercise controller.
Service account used to initiate the simulation on BUILD-LAB-03.

remediations.description: Close the case as a Benign event, as it was an authorized and contained simulation.
Evaluate if alert logic can be refined to incorporate approved change requests or known simulation activities to reduce future false positives.
